$comment: 01 PIL task scripts (FR-PIL-05). A goal is read aloud to the participant: plain job language, no command names (VC-PIL-03). oracle = production-gate criterion ids (tests/production/criteria/*) graded on the participant's final document and issued files, or a listed manual check. timeLimitMin = protocol parameter (spec budget), calibrated in the R1 dry run with the pilot lead and frozen before R2. core = counts toward EX-1 / EX-3c. critical = issues a deliverable or protects data (raw TLX after it). Coordinates: local site grid in metres, survey S5.

tasks.title: Bring in the survey
tasks.goal: Your surveyor sent pilot-site-survey.csv (point, easting, northing, level, code; metres). Bring every point into the drawing in metres and keep the codes.

tasks.title: Existing ground
tasks.start: after T-CIV-01 (or the moderator's checkpoint file)
tasks.goal: Build the existing-ground surface from the survey, with contours every 0.5 m and a heavier contour every 2.5 m.

tasks.title: Balanced building pad
tasks.goal: Place a building pad with corners (1150, 5110), (1200, 5110), (1200, 5150), (1150, 5150), cut batter 1.5 H : 1 V, fill batter 2 H : 1 V, and set its level so that the cut, bulked by 10 %, equals the fill. Tell me the level and the volumes.
tasks.endCondition: participant states level, cut and fill
tasks.manualCheck: stated values equal the document's values (±0.01 m, ±1 m³)

tasks.title: Access road alignment
tasks.goal: Lay out the access road through (1110, 5005), (1175, 5035), (1170, 5105) with a 60 m curve and 40 m transition spirals on each side, stations every 10 m.

tasks.title: Road design and checks
tasks.goal: Give the road a vertical profile through chainage 0 at 103.0, chainage 70 at 105.5 with a 40 m vertical curve, and chainage 130 at 109.5; 3 m lanes, 1 m shoulders, 2.5 % crossfall, 6 % maximum superelevation. Check it for 40 km/h and tell me if anything fails.

tasks.title: Storm network
tasks.goal: Add manholes MH1 (1178, 5100) invert 107.0, 0.2 ha at C 0.9; MH2 (1180, 5040) invert 104.3, 0.12 ha at C 0.85; MH3 (1120, 5012) invert 101.8, 0.6 ha at C 0.4; outfall (1072, 5012) invert 100.45; pipes MH1→MH2→MH3→outfall, n = 0.013. Size the pipes for i = 1000 / (t + 10)^0.8 mm/h.

tasks.title: Hydraulic check
tasks.goal: The stream at the outfall stands at 100.75. Check the network: is any pipe surcharged or any manhole flooding?

tasks.title: Issue to the contractor
tasks.goal: Issue the plan-profile sheet of the road on A2 with the title block filled (project 'Hillside business park — plot 4', drawing C-101, revision A) and the LandXML of the survey, surface, road and drainage. Save both files where I can open them.

tasks.title: Recover from a mistake
tasks.start: after T-CIV-08; the moderator asks the participant to save as pilot.llull.json
tasks.goal: Change the pad's fill batter to 3 H : 1 V and look at the volumes. That was a mistake: put it back exactly as it was. Then close the project, reopen it and show me the pad is still balanced.

tasks.title: Survey from a drawing
tasks.goal: This time the survey came as pilot-site-survey.dxf (3D contours and spot levels). Bring it in as survey points and build the surface.
oracle: manual: point count and level range equal those of an independent DXF reader (tests/production/oracle/dxf.ts)

expected.points: TBD — measure with tests/production/oracle/dxf.ts on S5

P-STL.note: Structure part of the extraction building (grid 4 × 6.0 m by 2 × 7.5 m, floors +6 / +12 / +18 m, HEB300 columns, IPE450 / IPE300 beams, CHS139.7x5 bracing). Task cards give the brief values; oracles are that scenario's criteria applied to the participant's model.

tasks.title: Grid and levels
tasks.goal: Set up grid lines 1–5 at 6 m and A–C at 7.5 m, and levels at ±0, +6, +12 and +18 m.

tasks.title: Columns
tasks.goal: Put an HEB300 column on every grid intersection from ±0 to +18 m.

tasks.title: Floor beams
tasks.goal: Frame each floor: IPE450 between grid lines A–C on every axis, IPE300 along A, B, C between axes; top of steel 30 mm under each floor level for the grating.

tasks.title: Bracing
tasks.goal: Brace bays 1–2 and 4–5 on lines A and C, and bays A–B on axes 1 and 5, with CHS139.7x5 crosses in every storey.

tasks.title: Verify the members
tasks.goal: Check every steel member and tell me which ones fail and why. Fix the beams under the extractor if they fail.
tasks.endCondition: participant states the outcome; any fix applied

tasks.title: Steel weight
tasks.goal: Tell me the total steel weight by section.
tasks.manualCheck: stated total equals the takeoff ±0.1 t

tasks.title: Issue drawings and model
tasks.goal: Issue the +6 m plan as a DXF and as a plan sheet with title block, and the IFC model.

tasks.title: Recover from a mistake
tasks.goal: Delete the bracing on line A by mistake, then get it back exactly; close, reopen, and show me it is all there.

P-PLT.note: Pipe rack (54 m, 10 bents HEB240 / IPE300, tiers +5.0 / +6.5 m, lines DN50–DN300, 600 mm tray, road crossing 4.5 m clear) and revision B of the extraction building.

tasks.title: Rack bents
tasks.goal: Build the 10 bents of the 54 m rack: HEB240 posts, IPE300 tier beams at +5.0 and +6.5 m, rigid joints.

tasks.title: Lines on the rack
tasks.goal: Run the nine lines of the line list card from battery limit to battery limit on their tier, at their DN.

tasks.title: Supports
tasks.goal: Support every line on every bent and check the spans.

tasks.title: Cable tray and road crossing
tasks.goal: Add the 600 mm tray on the upper tier and show me the clear height over the road.

tasks.title: Clash check
tasks.goal: Make sure nothing clashes; fix what does.

tasks.title: Line list and quantities
tasks.goal: Issue the line list and the metres of pipe per DN.

tasks.title: Revision B
tasks.goal: Apply change order B: extractor uprated to 18 m and 72 t, add pump E-502 and line L-105, mark revision B. Do not renumber anything that did not change.
oracle: revision criteria of desmet-extraction-revision-b (ids, marks, GlobalIds kept)

tasks.title: Issue IFC
tasks.goal: Issue the IFC model of revision B for the client's viewer.

P-MEC.note: Oracles marked 'unbuilt' wait for the mechanical production scenario; until then the moderator applies the manual checks, and P-MEC R1 cannot gate.

tasks.title: Base part
tasks.goal: Model a 120 × 80 × 10 mm plate.

tasks.title: Upright
tasks.goal: Add a 60 mm high, 10 mm thick upright along one 80 mm edge, joined to the plate.

tasks.title: Holes
tasks.goal: Drill four Ø9 through holes in the plate, centres 20 mm from each edge.

tasks.title: Fillet
tasks.goal: Round the inside corner between plate and upright with a 5 mm radius.

tasks.title: Mass
tasks.goal: Tell me the mass in steel at 7850 kg/m³.

tasks.title: Change a dimension
tasks.goal: The plate must be 140 mm long, holes still 20 mm from the edges. Update the part.
oracle: manual: bounding box 140 × 80 × 70; hole centres 20 mm from edges

tasks.title: Drawing
tasks.goal: Make a drawing sheet with front, top and side views, the overall dimensions and the hole callout, title block filled, and save it.
oracle: manual: 3 views, overall 140 / 80 / 70, 4 × Ø9 callout, title block complete

tasks.title: Send the 3D
tasks.goal: Send the part to the workshop as a STEP file and check it opens in your usual tool.
oracle: manual: incumbent reports one solid, same volume ±0.1 %
